capture_points.state: built (ids, sequences, loss, heartbeats); P1 (event ids, manifests)
capture_points.observes: Fabric's own records: ids, sequences, manifests, loss, heartbeats, modes; the Node's `fabric.source.authenticated` stamp
capture_points.cannot_observe: anything outside Fabric

capture_points.observes: tenant, deployment identity block, capture policy, build digest, framework identity as configured
capture_points.cannot_observe: anything not configured

capture_points.observes: matched POST model exchanges: request/response body bytes, timing, response state, HTTP status, error class, scope
capture_points.cannot_observe: headers; non-chat endpoints (images, audio, moderations, rerank, fine-tuning, files, batch); GET; realtime; unmatched hosts or paths; `requests`, `urllib3`/`boto3`, gRPC; `aiohttp` (see `wire.py.aiohttp`); TLS; provider-side receipt

capture_points.activation: opt-in with the wire input: `install()` or `FABRIC_WIRE_AUTOLOAD=1` (`FABRIC_WIRE_AIOHTTP=0` or `patch_aiohttp=False` turns it off)
capture_points.observes: matched POST model exchanges sent with `aiohttp.ClientSession`: in-memory request body bytes, every response body byte aiohttp received (decoded when aiohttp decompresses, recorded as `identity`), timing, response state, HTTP status, error class, scope
capture_points.cannot_observe: headers; streamed, file, form or generator request bodies (`transport_incomplete`); a per-request `auto_decompress` set on the request rather than the response handler; aiohttp WebSocket frames; everything `wire.py.httpx` cannot observe besides its own client
capture_points.passivity_gate: `sdk/python/tests/test_wire_aiohttp_passivity.py` (047 §4.10 budgets on the hook paths), `sdk/python/tests/test_wire_aiohttp.py` (results, exceptions, streamed chunks unchanged)

capture_points.state: TS track; manifest reports `unsupported` until built
capture_points.observes: global `fetch` model exchanges: request/response body chunks
capture_points.cannot_observe: axios, `node:http`, custom fetch, Node.js below 24, unqualified undici versions

capture_points.state: built (043); P1: records producer on the shared allocator and spool
capture_points.observes: model/tool/database/agent call bytes and lifecycle as handed to `CallRecorder`
capture_points.cannot_observe: anything not passed through the recorder

capture_points.state: built (043/044); P1: records producer on the shared allocator and spool

capture_points.cannot_observe: anything outside the declared boundary

capture_points.state: built (metadata, unsequenced); P1: records input on the shared allocator and spool; content roles P0-A/P2
capture_points.observes: `fabric.decision` records and spans: retrieval, memory, side effect, checkpoint, delegation, interaction, file, hook, skill, `tool_call()`, `llm_call()`; new P2/P3 reporting APIs; sequenced on the process source from P1
capture_points.cannot_observe: anything the application does not report

capture_points.observes: run id, scope, block exit status, session/parent/resume links, segment ids, predecessors and seals, resumable/terminal flags
capture_points.cannot_observe: work started outside a block (047 run-id fallback applies)

capture_points.observes: `tools/list` inventory, `tools/call` arguments and results through the wrapper
capture_points.cannot_observe: other MCP methods, notifications, server-to-client requests, unwrapped sessions

capture_points.observes: every JSON-RPC message a wrapped client session sends and receives, stdio and Streamable HTTP
capture_points.cannot_observe: server internals, other client libraries

capture_points.observes: argv, cwd, pid, exit code/signal; stdout/stderr only as returned by `communicate()` / `run(capture_output=True)`
capture_points.cannot_observe: bytes the caller reads directly from pipes; descendants; PTYs; environment values

capture_points.observes: exec-family audit events (`subprocess.Popen`, `os.system`, `os.exec*`, `os.posix_spawn`): executable, argv, cwd
capture_points.cannot_observe: output, exit, environment values

capture_points.observes: statement, parameters, rows the caller fetched, rows affected, commit/rollback calls
capture_points.cannot_observe: rows not fetched, server-side effects, other drivers, console access

capture_points.observes: method, status, host; path, query and bodies only for allowlisted hosts with a retaining role policy
capture_points.cannot_observe: headers, non-httpx clients, hosts not allowlisted

capture_points.observes: `open`, `os.rename`, `os.remove` audit events: path, mode, operation
capture_points.cannot_observe: bytes read or written (reported only), memory-mapped I/O, other processes

capture_points.observes: target, host-key verification result, command, channel bytes, exit status
capture_points.cannot_observe: direct `ssh`/`scp`, remote side, agent forwarding

capture_points.observes: automation actions and their results, screenshots the automation already produced
capture_points.cannot_observe: human browser tabs, pages not driven by the library

capture_points.observes: frames in both directions with timestamps on qualified realtime endpoints
capture_points.cannot_observe: WebRTC media, other clients

capture_points.observes: literal fields parsed from stored bytes (provenance inherited from the bytes)
capture_points.cannot_observe: anything not in stored bytes

capture_points.observes: inferred links and events by the closed methods of section 2.5
capture_points.cannot_observe: anything without a listed method
